from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The solid divider separates two equal-width noisy masks.
    div_col = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
    half = div_col
    left = [row[:half] for row in grid]
    right = [row[div_col + 1:div_col + 1 + half] for row in grid]
    left_bg = max(set(v for row in left for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in left for x in row))
    right_bg = max(set(v for row in right for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in right for x in row))
    left_mark = next(v for v in set(v for row in left for v in row) if v != left_bg)
    right_mark = next(v for v in set(v for row in right for v in row) if v != right_bg)
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == left_mark and right[r][c] != right_mark else right_bg for c in range(half)] for r in range(h)]
'''
path=programs/'task-9bf10bf1.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
